item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello there! It's Monday, September 28. Time for the weather! A fresh new week begins today. Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be damp with light drizzle. The warmest part of the day will be 28 degrees, and the coolest 24. It will feel lovely and warm. Rain is about 85 percent likely today. There are 3 days to go until a special day. Can you guess which one? Remember to take an umbrella with you! Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be sunny with a few showers, reaching 25 degrees. This week our theme is blustery days. Watch what the wind moves and what it does not. And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
